oracle.mapping: each target Up/Down row independently chooses any row from all fifteen other experts
oracle.coefficient: one exact FP64 slope and intercept per target role-row
oracle.legality: deliberately illegal many-to-one, role-inconsistent, uncharged reference/mapping/coefficients

decision.kill: pooled exact selected capture plus 0.001 absolute numerical/ranking cushion is below requirement
decision.promote: otherwise require matched controls, legal joint-role assignment, physical rate and read ledger

claim_boundary: A kill rejects same-layer cross-expert Up/Down neuron ancestry as the sole module closing the existing composite gap. Gate-role ancestry, arbitrary nonlinear shared decoders, and functional activation-weighted compression remain outside scope.
